evals.prompt: Extract Organization and Product JSON-LD entities from https://example.com and compute the Answerability Index.
evals.expected_output: Entity snapshot and weighted material attribute completeness score.
assertions: Decoupled @graph Offer nodes are linked to target Products
Non-HTML sitemaps are strictly excluded from answerability scoring

evals.prompt: Check whether product pages on https://example.com declare complete commercial attributes (price, currency, availability, description, sku).
evals.expected_output: Attribute completeness report for commercial product entities.
assertions: Missing price or currency triggers INCOMPLETE_OFFER_ATTRIBUTES
Product schema without name triggers MATERIAL_ENTITY_AMBIGUITY
Answerability score reflects percentage of complete commercial attributes
